frank.message: FRANK state instrumentation should expose semantic_state_hash, state_version_hash and trace_root_hash as distinct identities; loop/checkpoint state can use domain epochs without making history part of semantic content identity.

claycode.message: H2 needs explicit typed contracts for semantic-state identity, state/version identity, trace identity, domain epochs and semantic idempotency; execution-attempt metadata must not silently redefine semantic request identity.

clayresearch.message: The executable merge supports a layered identity architecture rather than a single overloaded state hash; evidence remains synthetic/shared-ancestry until target-host differential validation.

gwt.message: Ordered Workspace/re-entry sequences remain order-sensitive while explicitly set-valued state canonicalizes independently of enumeration order; GWT episode epochs should bind version, not semantic truth.

claygraph.message: Graph/run bindings should reference semantic identity and epoch/version identity separately; graph activation/topology metadata must not collapse into semantic state content hash.

unifieddb.message: Persistence/query contracts should preserve separate semantic-content, version/history and execution-trace identities; logical unification does not require one physical hash or store identity.

hyperposition.message: No new Hyperposition mechanism claim; candidate only preserves ordered versus set-valued identity semantics required by existing alternatives/topology work.

emergenz.message: Replay identity becomes cleaner for matched interventions, but successful deterministic replay is not causal-emergence evidence and no emergence claim is promoted.

harness.message: New merged oracle candidate and regression/stress evidence added. H-WP-02 remains CLAIMED/INCOMPLETE pending Ubuntu developer-host and live-baseline differential validation.
